decisions.choice: the Spirit of God came on him: God moved him to speak as a prophet
decisions.reason: In Chronicles the Spirit comes on a person to give him a message from God, as on Amasai (1 Chronicles 12:19), Jahaziel (2 Chronicles 20:14) and Zechariah son of Jehoiada (24:20). What follows in verses 2-7 is Azariah's message, and verse 8 calls it a prophecy.

decisions.choice: Azariah son of Oded: a prophet named only in this chapter
decisions.reason: Nothing else is known of him or of his father. His name means "Yahweh has helped". He meets Asa as the king comes back from his victory over Zerah the Cushite (14:8-14).

decisions.choice: The Spirit of God came on Azariah son of Oded
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names Azariah first and then says "on him came the Spirit of God", putting the prophet in front. Literal keeps that order; Balanced and Readable say it in one plain clause.

decisions.choice: "Azarías hijo de Oded"
decisions.reason: The prophet and his father take their usual Spanish forms.

decisions.choice: "Thần Linh của Đức Chúa Trời"
decisions.reason: The form of Genesis 1:2 and the Kings drafts for the Spirit of God moving a prophet to speak (m1).

decisions.choice: "하나님의 영이 오뎃의 아들 아사랴에게 임했다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names Azariah first; Balanced and Readable put the Spirit first, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Azarias, filho de Odede; o Espírito de Deus veio sobre ele
decisions.reason: The prophet (m2) takes the usual Brazilian form of the name, "Azarias", and his father the form "Odede", with the final "-e" Portuguese adds after a consonant, as "Ben-Hadade" in 1 Kings. "Veio sobre" renders the plain verb "was on" (m1); "revestiu", used for Amasai in 1 Chronicles 12:19 in Portuguese, belongs to a different Hebrew verb.

records.literal_gloss: And he went out before Asa and said to him, Hear me, Asa and all Judah and Benjamin: Yahweh [is] with you when you are with him; and if you seek him he will be found by you, and if you forsake him he will forsake you.

en.L: And he went out before Asa and said to him, "Hear me, Asa and all Judah and Benjamin: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] with you while you are with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. And if you seek {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will be found by you; but if you forsake {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will forsake you.
en.B: He went out to meet Asa and spoke to him: "Hear me, Asa, and all of Judah and Benjamin. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is with you as long as you are with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. If you seek {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will let you find {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; but if you abandon {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will abandon you.
en.R: He went out to meet Asa and said, "Listen to me, Asa, and all you people of Judah and Benjamin. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is with you as long as you stay with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. If you look for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, you will find {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. But if you turn away from {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will turn away from you.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 아사 앞으로 나가서 그에게 말했다. "아사 임금님과 온 유다와 베냐민은 제 말을 들으십시오. 여러분이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}와 함께 있는 동안 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여러분과 함께 계십니다. 여러분이 그분을 찾으면 그분께서 여러분에게 찾아지실 것이고, 여러분이 그분을 버리면 그분께서도 여러분을 버리실 것입니다.
ko.B: 그는 아사를 맞으러 나가서 말했다. "아사 임금님, 그리고 온 유다와 베냐민 백성은 제 말을 들으십시오. 여러분이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}와 함께 있는 한 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여러분과 함께 계십니다. 여러분이 그분을 찾으면 그분을 만나게 해 주실 것입니다. 그러나 여러분이 그분을 버리면 그분께서도 여러분을 버리실 것입니다.
ko.R: 그는 아사를 맞으러 나가서 말했다. "아사 임금님, 그리고 유다와 베냐민의 모든 백성은 제 말을 들으십시오. 여러분이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 곁에 머물러 있는 한 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여러분과 함께 계십니다. 여러분이 그분을 찾으면 그분을 만날 것입니다. 그러나 여러분이 그분에게서 돌아서면 그분께서도 여러분에게서 돌아서실 것입니다.

decisions.choice: went out before Asa: went out to meet him
decisions.reason: To go out "before" (literally "to the face of") someone is to go out to meet him. Asa is returning from the battle with Zerah (14:8-14).

decisions.choice: Yahweh is with you while you are with him: his help goes with their loyalty
decisions.reason: Asa had just seen Yahweh fight for him (14:10-12). Azariah tells the king and the people that Yahweh's presence and help are not automatic: they go with Judah's own faithfulness to him. The rest of the message and of Asa's story turns on this (16:7-9, 12).

decisions.choice: if you seek him he will be found by you; if you forsake him he will forsake you
decisions.reason: David says the same to Solomon in 1 Chronicles 28:9, "If you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will reject you forever". Here the second half is "he will forsake you", the same verb said back of Yahweh, as at 12:5 and 24:20. Moses promised that Israel would find Yahweh when they sought him (Deuteronomy 4:29). Verses 4 and 15 tell how the promise came true.

decisions.choice: you: plural, the king and the people together
decisions.reason: Every "you" in the message is plural. Azariah speaks to Asa and to all Judah and Benjamin at once; what follows applies to the whole people.

decisions.choice: he will let you find him (Balanced); you will find him (Readable)
decisions.reason: As at 1 Chronicles 28:9. The Hebrew says "he will be found by you": God lets himself be found. Balanced keeps God as the one who acts; Readable says it from the seeker's side, which means the same.

decisions.choice: abandon (Balanced); turn away from (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses one verb for both halves, "forsake ... forsake", and every level repeats one English verb to keep the matching sentence. Balanced uses "abandon" as at 1 Chronicles 28:9.

decisions.choice: plural_you spans through Azariah's message
decisions.reason: Every "you" of the message is plural, the king and the people together (meaning decision); Spanish marks each with the plural_you span, verbs and clitics included.

decisions.choice: "si lo buscan, se dejará hallar" (L, B); "lo encontrarán" (R)
decisions.reason: The words are David's in 1 Chronicles 28:9 (meaning decision); seeking Yahweh is "buscar" at every level, as in 14:3.

decisions.choice: "vous" to Asa and the people together
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "you" is plural, the king and the people together (m4), so the prophet says "vous" to them all, as French does for a group; "Écoutez-moi, Asa" addresses the king within the group.

decisions.choice: ataonekana kwenu (Literal); atawawezesha kumpata (Balanced); mtampata (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "he will let himself be found by you"; Literal keeps God as the subject, Balanced says that he lets them find him, and Readable that they will find him, as the English does.

decisions.choice: the prophet says "tôi" and "các người" to the king and people
decisions.reason: The "you" is plural, king and people together (m4). As Elijah to the people in 1 Kings 18, the prophet uses the plain "các người", not the commanding "các ngươi" of God or a king.

decisions.choice: The prophet speaks in 합쇼체 to the king and people, with "여러분" for the plural "you"
decisions.reason: Prophets speak to kings in 합쇼체 (terms note); the plural address (m4) takes the polite plural "여러분".

decisions.choice: buscar (every level); será achado por vocês (L), se deixará achar por vocês (B), vocês o acharão (R); abandonar (L, B), afastar-se (R)
decisions.reason: Azariah's promise uses the words of David's charge in 1 Chronicles 28:9 (m3), and the Portuguese keeps that verse's verbs: "buscar", the Chronicler's key word for seeking God, kept at every level as set at 1:5; "será achado" at Literal; at Balanced "se deixará achar", God letting himself be found (r-en-1). Each level repeats one verb in the two halves of the last sentence, as the Hebrew does (r-en-2). Verses 4 and 15 take the same words back.

decisions.choice: vocês (Azariah to the king and the people)
decisions.reason: Every "you" in the message is plural (m4): the prophet speaks to Asa and the whole people at once, so Portuguese says "vocês" throughout, the plural a prophet uses to his hearers in Kings; "o rei" would leave the people out.

ko.L: 그리고 오랫동안 이스라엘에는 참 하나님도 없었고, 가르치는 제사장도 없었고, 율법도 없었습니다.
ko.B: 이스라엘은 오랫동안 참 하나님도 없이, 가르치는 제사장도 없이, 율법도 없이 지냈습니다.
ko.R: 오랫동안 이스라엘은 참 하나님 없이 살았습니다. 가르쳐 주는 제사장도 없었고, 율법도 없었습니다.

pt.L: E muitos dias [foram] para Israel sem um Deus verdadeiro, e sem um sacerdote que ensinasse, e sem lei.
pt.B: Israel passou muito tempo sem o Deus verdadeiro, sem sacerdote para ensinar e sem lei.
pt.R: Durante muito tempo, Israel viveu sem o Deus verdadeiro, sem um sacerdote para ensinar o povo e sem a lei.

decisions.choice: a long time in the past, most likely the days of the judges
alternatives: of the present: the northern kingdom in Azariah's day
of the future: a warning of what will happen if they forsake Yahweh
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has no verb: "many days to Israel without ...". It can be read of the past, of Azariah's own time, or of the future. Verses 4-6 use past-tense verbs and describe a time of disorder and turning back to Yahweh like the days of the judges (Judges 2:11-19; 21:25), so the record reads the past. Some read it of the northern kingdom in Azariah's day, cut off from the priests of Jerusalem (11:13-15; 13:9), or as a warning of what is to come, as Hosea 3:4 speaks of Israel living many days without king or sacrifice.

decisions.choice: a true God: the real God, who is faithful
decisions.reason: "God of truth" means the God who is real and keeps faith, as against gods that are nothing (Jeremiah 10:10). Israel was without him not because he left, but because they no longer knew or served him.

decisions.choice: a teaching priest; law: the instruction priests gave
decisions.reason: One of the priests' tasks was to teach Israel Yahweh's instruction (Leviticus 10:11; Deuteronomy 33:10; Malachi 2:7). The word for law is the same as "teaching" or "instruction": without priests who taught, the people did not know what Yahweh required. Jehoshaphat later sends priests and Levites through Judah to teach the book of the law (17:7-9).

decisions.choice: went ... without (Balanced); lived without (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply a past-tense verb, following the reading in m1. Literal brackets "were".

decisions.choice: um sacerdote que ensinasse (L), sacerdote para ensinar (B, R); lei, a lei (lowercase)
decisions.reason: The priest's task was to teach (m3), so Portuguese uses a clause, as it has no common adjective for a "teaching" priest. "Lei" stays lowercase, as the English "law": the word here is the priests' instruction in general (m3), not the title of a book.

source.text: וַיָּ֨שָׁב֙ בַּצַּר־ל֔וֹ עַל־יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיְבַקְשֻׁ֖הוּ וַיִּמָּצֵ֥א לָהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: But turned in [the] distress of him to Yahweh God of Israel, and they sought him, and he was found by them.

en.L: But in its distress [Israel] turned to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the God of Israel, and they sought {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was found by them.
en.B: But in their distress they turned back to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the God of Israel; they sought {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} let them find {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: But when they were in trouble, they turned back to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel. They looked for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and they found {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Pero en su angustia [Israel] se volvió {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, y lo buscaron, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se dejó hallar por ellos.
es.B: Pero en su angustia se volvieron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel; lo buscaron, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se dejó encontrar por ellos.
es.R: Pero cuando estaban en apuros, se volvieron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel. Lo buscaron, y lo encontraron.

fr.L: Mais dans sa détresse, [Israël] est revenu {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, et ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ont recherché, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est laissé trouver par eux.
fr.B: Mais dans leur détresse, ils sont revenus {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël ; ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ont recherché, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est laissé trouver par eux.
fr.R: Mais quand ils étaient dans le malheur, ils sont revenus {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël. Ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ont cherché, et ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ont trouvé.

sw.L: Lakini katika dhiki yao [Israeli] wakamrudia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wa Israeli, wakamtafuta, naye akaonekana kwao.
sw.B: Lakini katika dhiki yao walimrudia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli; walimtafuta, naye akawawezesha kumpata.
sw.R: Lakini walipokuwa katika taabu, walimrudia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli. Walimtafuta, nao wakampata.

vi.L: Nhưng trong cơn khốn khó, [Y-sơ-ra-ên] quay về với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên; họ tìm cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho họ gặp được.
vi.B: Nhưng trong cơn khốn khó, họ quay về với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên. Họ tìm cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho họ gặp được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Nhưng khi gặp hoạn nạn, họ quay về với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên. Họ tìm kiếm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và họ đã gặp được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그러나 [이스라엘이] 괴로울 때에 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 돌아와 그분을 찾았고, 그분께서 그들에게 찾아지셨습니다.
ko.B: 그러나 그들은 괴로울 때에 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 돌아와 그분을 찾았고, 그분께서는 그들이 그분을 만나게 해 주셨습니다.
ko.R: 그러나 그들은 어려움을 당하자 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 돌아왔습니다. 그들이 그분을 찾았을 때 그분을 만났습니다.

pt.L: Mas na sua angústia [Israel] se voltou para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, e eles {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} buscaram, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} foi achado por eles.
pt.B: Mas, na sua angústia, eles se voltaram para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel; eles {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} buscaram, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se deixou achar por eles.
pt.R: Mas, quando estavam em dificuldade, eles se voltaram de novo para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel. Eles {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} buscaram e {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} acharam.

decisions.choice: in distress Israel turned back to Yahweh: the pattern of the judges
decisions.reason: Again and again in Judges the people cried to Yahweh in their trouble and he raised up someone to rescue them (Judges 2:18; 3:9, 15; 10:10-16). Azariah reminds Asa that the promise of verse 2 has proved true before. The verbs may also describe what happened each time: whenever they turned back, he let them find him.

decisions.choice: it turned ... they sought: Israel as one people and as many
decisions.reason: The first verb is singular, with Israel (verse 3) as one people; the next is plural, the people together. Both mean the same people.

decisions.choice: they sought him and he was found by them
decisions.reason: The same words as the promise in verse 2. Verse 15 tells how it came true again for Asa's Judah.

decisions.choice: [Israel] (Literal); they (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The verb has no named subject. Literal names Israel in brackets; Balanced and Readable say "they", since the people are meant (m2). "Let them find him" and "found him" as in verse 2.

decisions.choice: "Ngài cho họ gặp được" (L, B); "họ đã gặp được Ngài" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "he was found by them" means God lets himself be found; Literal and Balanced keep God as the one who acts, Readable says what happened, as the English does in verses 2, 4 and 15.

decisions.choice: "찾아지셨습니다" (L), "만나게 해 주셨습니다" (B), "그분을 만났습니다" (R)
decisions.reason: "He was found by them" (m3); Balanced says that God let himself be found, as the English Balanced does, and keeps the honorific.

decisions.choice: buscaram ... foi achado (L), se deixou achar (B), acharam (R)
decisions.reason: The words of the promise in verse 2 (m3) at each level, so that the reader hears it being kept; Portuguese uses "buscar" here too, though the Hebrew verb is a different one from verse 2's, as the English uses "seek" for both. Literal keeps the singular verb with "[Israel]" and then the plural (m2).

source.text: וּבָעִתִּ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם אֵ֥ין שָׁל֖וֹם לַיּוֹצֵ֣א וְלַבָּ֑א כִּ֚י מְהוּמֹ֣ת רַבּ֔וֹת עַ֥ל כָּל־יוֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאֲרָצֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And in the times those there was no peace for the [one] going out and for the [one] coming in, for disturbances great [were] on all [the] inhabitants of the lands.

en.L: And in those times there was no peace for the [one] going out and for the [one] coming in, for great disturbances [were] on all the inhabitants of the lands.
en.B: In those times there was no peace for anyone who went out or came in, because great turmoil troubled all who lived in those lands.
en.R: In those days it was not safe to travel anywhere. All the people who lived in those lands were in great trouble and confusion.

es.L: Y en aquellos tiempos no había paz para el que salía ni para el que entraba, porque grandes turbaciones [había] sobre todos los habitantes de las tierras.
es.B: En aquellos tiempos no había paz para nadie que saliera o entrara, porque grandes turbaciones afligían a todos los que vivían en aquellas tierras.
es.R: En aquellos días no era seguro viajar a ningún lugar. Toda la gente que vivía en aquellas tierras sufría grandes problemas y confusión.

fr.L: Et en ces temps-là, il n’y avait pas de paix pour celui qui sortait ni pour celui qui entrait, car de grands troubles [étaient] sur tous les habitants des pays.
fr.B: En ces temps-là, il n’y avait pas de paix pour qui sortait ou entrait, car de grands troubles frappaient tous les habitants de ces pays.
fr.R: À cette époque, on ne pouvait aller nulle part en sécurité. Tous les habitants de ces pays vivaient dans le désordre et la peur.

sw.L: Na nyakati zile hapakuwa na amani kwa anayetoka wala kwa anayeingia, kwa maana fujo kubwa [zilikuwa] juu ya wakaaji wote wa nchi.
sw.B: Nyakati zile hapakuwa na amani kwa mtu yeyote aliyetoka wala aliyeingia, kwa sababu ghasia kubwa ziliwasumbua wote walioishi katika nchi zile.
sw.R: Siku zile haikuwa salama kusafiri popote. Watu wote walioishi katika nchi zile walikuwa katika taabu kubwa na machafuko.

vi.L: Trong những thời ấy, không có bình an cho người đi ra cũng như người đi vào, vì những rối loạn lớn [đè] trên mọi cư dân các xứ.
vi.B: Trong những thời ấy, không ai đi ra đi vào được bình an, vì cảnh hỗn loạn lớn đè nặng trên mọi người sống trong các xứ ấy.
vi.R: Thời ấy, đi đâu cũng không được an toàn. Tất cả những người sống trong các xứ ấy đều gặp nhiều khốn khó và hỗn loạn.

ko.L: 그리고 그 시대에는 나가는 자에게도 들어오는 자에게도 평안이 없었습니다. 그 땅들에 사는 모든 사람에게 큰 혼란이 있었기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 그 시대에는 나가고 들어오는 사람 누구에게도 평안이 없었습니다. 여러 땅에 사는 모든 사람이 큰 혼란에 빠져 있었기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 그때에는 어디를 다녀도 안전하지 않았습니다. 그 땅들에 사는 모든 사람이 큰 어려움과 혼란을 겪었습니다.

pt.L: E naqueles tempos não [havia] paz para quem saía nem para quem entrava, pois grandes tumultos [havia] sobre todos os habitantes das terras.
pt.B: Naqueles tempos não havia paz para ninguém que saísse ou entrasse, porque grandes tumultos perturbavam todos os que viviam naquelas terras.
pt.R: Naquele tempo não era seguro viajar para lugar nenhum. Todos os que moravam naquelas terras viviam em grande aflição e confusão.

decisions.choice: no peace for the one going out and the one coming in: no safety in daily life
decisions.reason: Going out and coming in takes in all the ordinary movement of life: travel, trade, work in the fields. In such times no one could go about safely, as in the days of Shamgar and Jael when the roads were deserted (Judges 5:6).

decisions.choice: great disturbances: turmoil and panic
decisions.reason: The word means uproar or confusion, often the panic Yahweh sends on his enemies (Deuteronomy 7:23; 1 Samuel 5:9). Verse 6 says that God himself sent it.

decisions.choice: the lands: the regions where Israel lived
decisions.reason: The plural may mean the territories of the tribes of Israel, or Israel and the neighboring countries together. Either way the disorder was everywhere.

decisions.choice: it was not safe to travel anywhere
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom (m1) in plain words, and says "trouble and confusion" for the word in m2.

source.text: וְכֻתְּת֥וּ גוֹי־בְּג֖וֹי וְעִ֣יר בְּעִ֑יר כִּֽי־אֱלֹהִ֥ים הֲמָמָ֖ם בְּכָל־צָרָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And they were crushed, nation by nation and city by city, for God troubled them with every distress.

en.L: And they were crushed, nation by nation and city by city, for God troubled them with every distress.
en.B: Nation was crushed by nation and city by city, because God troubled them with every kind of distress.
en.R: One nation crushed another, and one city crushed another, because God brought all kinds of trouble on them.

es.L: Y eran quebrantados, nación por nación y ciudad por ciudad, porque Dios los turbó con toda clase de angustia.
es.B: Una nación era destrozada por otra nación, y una ciudad por otra ciudad, porque Dios los turbaba con toda clase de angustias.
es.R: Una nación destruía a otra, y una ciudad destruía a otra, porque Dios les envió toda clase de problemas.

fr.L: Et ils étaient écrasés, nation contre nation et ville contre ville, car Dieu les troublait par toutes sortes de détresses.
fr.B: Une nation était écrasée par une autre, une ville par une autre, car Dieu les troublait par toutes sortes de détresses.
fr.R: Une nation en écrasait une autre, une ville en écrasait une autre, parce que Dieu leur envoyait toutes sortes de malheurs.

sw.L: Wakavunjwa, taifa kwa taifa na mji kwa mji, kwa maana Mungu aliwafadhaisha kwa kila dhiki.
sw.B: Taifa lilivunjwa na taifa, na mji kwa mji, kwa sababu Mungu aliwasumbua kwa kila aina ya dhiki.
sw.R: Taifa moja liliangamiza taifa lingine, na mji mmoja uliangamiza mji mwingine, kwa sababu Mungu aliwaletea kila aina ya taabu.

vi.L: Họ bị nghiền nát, dân này bởi dân kia và thành này bởi thành kia, vì Đức Chúa Trời làm họ rối loạn bằng mọi thứ khốn khó.
vi.B: Dân này bị dân kia nghiền nát, thành này bị thành kia nghiền nát, vì Đức Chúa Trời làm họ rối loạn bằng đủ mọi khốn khó.
vi.R: Nước này đè bẹp nước kia, thành này đè bẹp thành kia, vì Đức Chúa Trời giáng đủ mọi tai họa trên họ.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 나라와 나라, 성읍과 성읍으로 부서졌습니다. 하나님께서 온갖 고난으로 그들을 어지럽게 하셨기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 나라가 나라를, 성읍이 성읍을 짓밟았습니다. 하나님께서 온갖 고난으로 그들을 괴롭게 하셨기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 한 나라가 다른 나라를 짓밟고, 한 성읍이 다른 성읍을 짓밟았습니다. 하나님께서 그들에게 온갖 어려움을 내리셨기 때문입니다.

pt.L: E foram esmagados, nação por nação e cidade por cidade, pois Deus os perturbou com toda angústia.
pt.B: Uma nação era esmagada por outra, e uma cidade por outra, porque Deus os perturbava com todo tipo de angústia.
pt.R: Uma nação esmagava a outra, e uma cidade esmagava a outra, porque Deus mandava todo tipo de sofrimento sobre eles.

decisions.choice: crushed, nation by nation and city by city: they broke one another
alternatives: nation against nation and city against city
decisions.reason: The preposition can mean "by" or "against". The sense is that peoples and towns fought and broke each other, not only that they suffered from outside enemies.

decisions.choice: God troubled them: the disorder was his judgment
decisions.reason: The verb means to throw into confusion, as Yahweh did to Egypt's army and to Israel's enemies (Exodus 14:24; Deuteronomy 7:23). Here he does it to his own people who had left him, as Judges 2:14-15 says.

decisions.choice: One nation crushed another, and one city crushed another
decisions.reason: Readable turns the passive into an active sentence and spells out the meaning in m1.

source.text: וְאַתֶּ֣ם חִזְק֔וּ וְאַל־יִרְפּ֖וּ יְדֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֛י יֵ֥שׁ שָׂכָ֖ר לִפְעֻלַּתְכֶֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And you, be strong and not let drop your hands, for there is reward for your work.

en.L: And you, be strong, and do not let your hands drop, for there is a reward for your work."
en.B: But as for you, be strong and do not let your hands go slack, for your work will be rewarded."
en.R: But you must be strong and not lose heart. What you do will be rewarded."

es.L: Y {{plural_you:ustedes, esfuércense|vosotros, esforzaos}}, y no {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} caer {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} manos, porque hay recompensa para {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} obra».
es.B: Pero en cuanto a {{plural_you:ustedes, sean fuertes y no dejen|vosotros, sed fuertes y no dejéis}} que se debiliten {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} manos, porque {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} trabajo tendrá recompensa».
es.R: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes deben ser fuertes y no desanimarse|vosotros debéis ser fuertes y no desanimaros}}. Lo que {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} tendrá su recompensa».

fr.L: Et vous, soyez forts, et ne laissez pas retomber vos mains, car il y a une récompense pour votre œuvre. »
fr.B: Mais vous, soyez forts et ne laissez pas vos mains faiblir, car votre œuvre sera récompensée. »
fr.R: Mais vous, soyez forts et ne perdez pas courage. Ce que vous faites sera récompensé. »

sw.L: Lakini ninyi, iweni hodari, wala mikono yenu isilegee, kwa maana kuna thawabu kwa kazi yenu."
sw.B: Lakini ninyi, iweni hodari wala msiiache mikono yenu ilegee, kwa maana kazi yenu italipwa."
sw.R: Lakini ninyi lazima muwe hodari wala msikate tamaa. Mtapata thawabu kwa kazi yenu."

vi.L: Còn các người, hãy mạnh mẽ lên, đừng để tay mình rã rời, vì công việc của các người sẽ có phần thưởng."
vi.B: Còn các người, hãy mạnh mẽ lên và đừng để tay mình buông xuôi, vì công việc của các người sẽ được ban thưởng."
vi.R: Nhưng các người phải mạnh mẽ và đừng nản lòng. Việc các người làm sẽ được ban thưởng."

ko.L: 그러나 여러분은 강해지십시오. 여러분의 손을 늘어뜨리지 마십시오. 여러분의 일에는 상이 있을 것입니다."
ko.B: 그러나 여러분은 힘을 내십시오. 손을 늘어뜨리지 마십시오. 여러분이 한 일에 상이 있을 것입니다."
ko.R: 그러니 여러분은 힘을 내고 낙심하지 마십시오. 여러분이 하는 일에는 반드시 상이 있을 것입니다."

pt.L: E vocês, sejam fortes, e não deixem cair as suas mãos, pois há recompensa para o trabalho de vocês."
pt.B: Mas vocês, sejam fortes e não deixem as mãos enfraquecerem, porque o trabalho de vocês será recompensado."
pt.R: Mas vocês precisam ser fortes e não desanimar. O que vocês fazem será recompensado."

decisions.choice: do not let your hands drop: do not lose courage or give up
decisions.reason: Hands that hang down are a picture of weakness and losing heart (2 Samuel 4:1; Isaiah 13:7; Zephaniah 3:16). Azariah urges the king and people to keep going with the work of turning Judah back to Yahweh.

decisions.choice: there is a reward for your work
decisions.reason: The same words are found in Jeremiah 31:16, said to Rachel weeping for her children. Faithful work for Yahweh is not wasted: verse 15 tells of the rest that followed.

decisions.choice: and you: in contrast with those times
decisions.reason: The pronoun is stressed. After the picture of the past (verses 3-6), Azariah turns to Asa and the people: their time can be different.

decisions.choice: go slack (Balanced); not lose heart (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture of hands with a natural verb; Readable gives the meaning (m1). Here the speech that began in verse 2 ends.

decisions.choice: "no dejen caer sus manos" (L); "no dejen que se debiliten sus manos" (B); "no desanimarse" (R)
decisions.reason: Hands that drop are a picture of losing heart (meaning decision); Literal keeps the image, Readable says what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: não deixem cair as suas mãos (L); o trabalho de vocês
decisions.reason: With "vocês", "suas mãos" could be read as "his" or "their" hands, but after the stressed "E vocês" the owner is plain; for the work, "de vocês" is written out, as the style asks where "seu" would be ambiguous.

source.text: וְכִשְׁמֹ֨עַ אָסָ֜א הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה וְהַנְּבוּאָה֮ עֹדֵ֣ד הַנָּבִיא֒ הִתְחַזַּ֗ק וַיַּעֲבֵ֤ר הַשִּׁקּוּצִים֙ מִכָּל־אֶ֤רֶץ יְהוּדָה֙ וּבִנְיָמִ֔ן וּמִן־הֶ֣עָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָכַ֖ד מֵהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַיְחַדֵּשׁ֙ אֶת־מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֕ר לִפְנֵ֖י אוּלָ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And when heard Asa the words these and the prophecy, Oded the prophet, he took courage and removed the detestable things from all [the] land of Judah and Benjamin and from the cities which he had captured from [the] hill country of Ephraim; and he renewed [the] altar of Yahweh which [was] before [the] porch of Yahweh.

en.L: And when Asa heard these words and the prophecy [of] Oded the prophet, he took courage, and he removed the detestable things from all the land of Judah and Benjamin and from the cities that he had captured from [the] hill country of Ephraim; and he renewed the altar of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that [was] before the porch of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: When Asa heard these words and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he gathered his courage. He removed the detestable idols from all the land of Judah and Benjamin and from the towns he had captured in the hill country of Ephraim, and he repaired the altar of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that stood in front of the porch of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple.
en.R: When Asa heard these words, the message from the prophet Oded, he was encouraged. He got rid of the disgusting idols throughout the land of Judah and Benjamin, and from the towns he had captured in the hill country of Ephraim. He also repaired the altar of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in front of the porch of the temple.

es.L: Y cuando Asá oyó estas palabras y la profecía [de] Oded el profeta, cobró ánimo, y quitó las abominaciones de toda la tierra de Judá y de Benjamín, y de las ciudades que había tomado en la región montañosa de Efraín; y renovó el altar {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que [estaba] delante del pórtico {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Cuando Asá oyó estas palabras y la profecía del profeta Oded, cobró ánimo. Quitó los ídolos detestables de toda la tierra de Judá y de Benjamín, y de las ciudades que había tomado en la región montañosa de Efraín, y reparó el altar {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que estaba delante del pórtico del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Cuando Asá oyó estas palabras, el mensaje del profeta Oded, se animó. Se deshizo de los ídolos repugnantes de toda la tierra de Judá y de Benjamín, y de las ciudades que había tomado en la región montañosa de Efraín. También reparó el altar {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que estaba delante del pórtico del templo.

fr.L: Et quand Asa entendit ces paroles et la prophétie [d’]Oded le prophète, il prit courage, et il fit disparaître les abominations de tout le pays de Juda et de Benjamin, et des villes qu’il avait prises dans la montagne d’Éphraïm ; et il renouvela l’autel {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} qui [était] devant le vestibule {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Quand Asa entendit ces paroles et la prophétie d’Oded le prophète, il prit courage. Il fit disparaître les idoles abominables de tout le pays de Juda et de Benjamin, et des villes qu’il avait prises dans la montagne d’Éphraïm, et il restaura l’autel {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} qui se trouvait devant le vestibule du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Quand Asa a entendu ces paroles, le message du prophète Oded, il a repris courage. Il s’est débarrassé des idoles répugnantes dans tout le pays de Juda et de Benjamin, et dans les villes qu’il avait prises dans la région montagneuse d’Éphraïm. Il a aussi réparé l’autel {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, devant le vestibule du temple.

sw.L: Asa alipoyasikia maneno haya na unabii wa Odedi nabii, akajipa moyo, akaondoa machukizo katika nchi yote ya Yuda na Benyamini na katika miji aliyoiteka katika nchi ya milima ya Efraimu; akaifanya upya madhabahu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} iliyokuwa mbele ya baraza la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Asa aliposikia maneno haya na unabii wa Odedi nabii, alipata ujasiri. Akaziondoa sanamu za kuchukiza katika nchi yote ya Yuda na Benyamini na katika miji aliyoiteka katika nchi ya milima ya Efraimu, akaitengeneza upya madhabahu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} iliyokuwa mbele ya baraza la nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Asa aliposikia maneno haya, ujumbe wa nabii Odedi, alitiwa moyo. Akaziondoa sanamu za kuchukiza katika nchi yote ya Yuda na Benyamini, na katika miji aliyoiteka katika nchi ya milima ya Efraimu. Akaitengeneza pia madhabahu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} iliyokuwa mbele ya baraza la hekalu.

vi.L: Khi A-sa nghe những lời này và lời tiên tri [của] nhà tiên tri Ô-đết, ông vững lòng, và dẹp bỏ những vật gớm ghiếc khỏi khắp xứ Giu-đa và Bên-gia-min, cùng khỏi các thành ông đã chiếm trong vùng đồi núi Ép-ra-im; ông cũng sửa lại bàn thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở trước tiền sảnh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Khi A-sa nghe những lời này và lời tiên tri của nhà tiên tri Ô-đết, vua vững lòng. Vua dẹp bỏ các thần tượng gớm ghiếc khỏi khắp xứ Giu-đa và Bên-gia-min, cùng khỏi các thành vua đã chiếm trong vùng đồi núi Ép-ra-im, và vua sửa lại bàn thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở trước tiền sảnh đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Khi A-sa nghe những lời này, là sứ điệp của nhà tiên tri Ô-đết, vua được thêm can đảm. Vua dẹp bỏ các thần tượng ghê tởm trong khắp xứ Giu-đa và Bên-gia-min, và trong các thành vua đã chiếm ở vùng đồi núi Ép-ra-im. Vua cũng sửa lại bàn thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở trước tiền sảnh đền thờ.

ko.L: 그리고 아사가 이 말씀들과 예언자 오뎃의 예언을 들었을 때에, 그가 용기를 내어 유다와 베냐민 온 땅과 그가 에브라임 산지에서 빼앗은 성읍들에서 가증한 것들을 없앴다. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 현관 앞에 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 제단을 새롭게 했다.
ko.B: 아사는 이 말씀, 곧 예언자 오뎃의 예언을 듣고 용기를 냈다. 그는 유다와 베냐민 온 땅과 자기가 에브라임 산지에서 빼앗은 성읍들에서 가증한 우상들을 없앴다. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전 현관 앞에 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 제단을 고쳐 쌓았다.
ko.R: 아사는 이 말씀, 곧 예언자 오뎃의 말을 듣고 힘을 얻었다. 그는 유다와 베냐민 온 땅과 자기가 에브라임 산지에서 빼앗은 성읍들에서 역겨운 우상들을 없앴다. 그리고 성전 현관 앞에 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 제단을 고쳐 쌓았다.

pt.L: E, quando Asa ouviu estas palavras e a profecia [de] Odede, o profeta, ele se encorajou e removeu as coisas detestáveis de toda a terra de Judá e de Benjamim e das cidades que tinha tomado da região montanhosa de Efraim; e renovou o altar {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} que [estava] diante do pórtico {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Quando Asa ouviu essas palavras e a profecia do profeta Odede, ele criou coragem. Removeu os ídolos detestáveis de toda a terra de Judá e de Benjamim e das cidades que tinha tomado na região montanhosa de Efraim, e restaurou o altar {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} que ficava em frente ao pórtico da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Quando Asa ouviu essas palavras, a mensagem do profeta Odede, ele ficou animado. Ele se livrou dos ídolos nojentos em toda a terra de Judá e de Benjamim e nas cidades que tinha tomado na região montanhosa de Efraim. Ele também consertou o altar {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} que ficava em frente ao pórtico do templo.

decisions.choice: the prophecy, Oded the prophet: the text as it stands
alternatives: the prophecy of Azariah son of Oded the prophet
decisions.reason: Verse 1 names the speaker as Azariah son of Oded, but here the Hebrew text reads only "the prophecy, Oded the prophet". Some ancient translations (the Syriac and the Latin) read "Azariah son of Oded" here, and the words "Azariah son of" may have dropped out in copying. The record keeps the Hebrew text at every level; the prophecy meant is the one in verses 2-7.

decisions.choice: the detestable things: idols
decisions.reason: The word is used for idols and the objects of other gods' worship, always with disgust (Deuteronomy 29:16; 1 Kings 11:5, 7). It names the images Asa had begun to remove at the start of his reign (14:2-4).

decisions.choice: the towns he had captured in the hill country of Ephraim
decisions.reason: Chronicles does not tell of these captures. Abijah, Asa's father, had taken Bethel and other towns from Jeroboam (13:19), and 17:2 speaks of the towns of Ephraim that Asa captured, so the border with Israel had moved north into Ephraim's hill country.

decisions.choice: renewed the altar: restored the great altar of burnt offering
decisions.reason: The verb means to make new or restore. The altar "before the porch" is the bronze altar that stood in the courtyard in front of the temple porch (4:1; 8:12). Some sixty years after Solomon it needed repair, or had to be cleansed and rededicated for the sacrifices of verse 11.

decisions.choice: detestable idols (Balanced); disgusting idols (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "detestable things"; Balanced and Readable say what the things were (m2).

decisions.choice: the porch of the LORD's temple (Balanced); the porch of the temple (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "the porch of Yahweh", meaning the porch of his house. Balanced and Readable name the temple so that the porch is not taken as something else; Readable also says "the message from the prophet Oded" for "the prophecy", which means the same.

decisions.choice: "las abominaciones" (L); "los ídolos detestables" (B); "los ídolos repugnantes" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Spanish of 2 Kings sets for abominations, with "ídolos" at Balanced and Readable, as the English says "idols".

decisions.choice: "lời tiên tri [của] nhà tiên tri Ô-đết"
alternatives: lời tiên tri của A-xa-ria con trai Ô-đết
decisions.reason: The text as it stands names Oded (m1); Vietnamese does not correct it from verse 1.

decisions.choice: "가증한 것들" (L), "가증한 우상들" (B), "역겨운 우상들" (R)
decisions.reason: The detestable things are idols (m2); "가증한" (L, B) and "역겨운" (R) as the Korean Kings.

decisions.choice: a profecia [de] Odede, o profeta (L); a profecia do profeta Odede (B, R)
alternatives: a profecia de Azarias, filho de Odede
decisions.reason: Portuguese follows the Hebrew as it stands (m1), as the English does, and does not add "Azarias, filho de"; the meaning note tells the reader about the other reading.

decisions.choice: as coisas detestáveis (L), os ídolos detestáveis (B), os ídolos nojentos (R); o pórtico da casa do SENHOR (B), do templo (R)
decisions.reason: Readable's "nojento" is the word 1 Kings 15:13 uses in Portuguese for Maacah's idol (verse 16). "Pórtico" is the word 1 Kings 6:3 uses in Portuguese for the temple porch; Balanced says "a casa do SENHOR" and Readable "o templo", as set for the whole book at 1:18.

source.text: וַיִּקְבֹּ֗ץ אֶת־כָּל־יְהוּדָה֙ וּבִנְיָמִ֔ן וְהַגָּרִים֙ עִמָּהֶ֔ם מֵאֶפְרַ֥יִם וּמְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וּמִשִּׁמְע֑וֹן כִּֽי־נָפְל֨וּ עָלָ֤יו מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל֙ לָרֹ֔ב בִּרְאֹתָ֕ם כִּֽי־יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָ֖יו עִמּֽוֹ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin and those sojourning with them from Ephraim and Manasseh and from Simeon, for they had fallen to him from Israel in abundance when they saw that Yahweh his God [was] with him.

en.L: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and those sojourning with them from Ephraim and Manasseh and from Simeon, for they had fallen to him from Israel in abundance, when they saw that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God [was] with him.
en.B: He assembled all Judah and Benjamin, and the people from Ephraim, Manasseh and Simeon who were living among them as outsiders. Great numbers had deserted to him from Israel, because they saw that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God was with him.
en.R: He called together all the people of Judah and Benjamin, and the people from Ephraim, Manasseh and Simeon who had come to live among them. Large numbers of people had left Israel and come over to Asa, because they saw that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God was with him.

es.L: Y reunió a todo Judá y Benjamín, y a los forasteros que estaban con ellos de Efraín y de Manasés y de Simeón, porque muchos de Israel se habían pasado a él al ver que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios [estaba] con él.
es.B: Reunió a todo Judá y Benjamín, y a la gente de Efraín, Manasés y Simeón que vivía entre ellos como forasteros. Muchos de Israel se habían pasado a su lado, porque vieron que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios estaba con él.
es.R: Reunió a todo el pueblo de Judá y de Benjamín, y a la gente de Efraín, Manasés y Simeón que había venido a vivir entre ellos. Muchos habían dejado Israel y se habían pasado a Asá, porque vieron que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios estaba con él.

fr.L: Et il rassembla tout Juda et Benjamin, et ceux d’Éphraïm, de Manassé et de Siméon qui séjournaient avec eux, car beaucoup d’Israël étaient passés à lui, quand ils avaient vu que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu [était] avec lui.
fr.B: Il rassembla tout Juda et Benjamin, ainsi que les gens d’Éphraïm, de Manassé et de Siméon qui vivaient parmi eux comme étrangers. Un grand nombre de gens d’Israël étaient passés de son côté en voyant que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu était avec lui.
fr.R: Il a réuni tout le peuple de Juda et de Benjamin, et les gens d’Éphraïm, de Manassé et de Siméon qui étaient venus vivre parmi eux. Beaucoup de gens avaient quitté Israël pour rejoindre Asa, parce qu’ils voyaient que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu était avec lui.

sw.L: Akawakusanya Yuda wote na Benyamini, na wale waliokaa kama wageni pamoja nao kutoka Efraimu na Manase na kutoka Simeoni, kwa maana walikuwa wamemwangukia kutoka Israeli kwa wingi, walipoona kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake [yuko] pamoja naye.
sw.B: Aliwakusanya Yuda wote na Benyamini, pamoja na watu wa Efraimu, Manase na Simeoni walioishi kati yao kama wageni. Watu wengi sana walikuwa wamehamia kwake kutoka Israeli, kwa sababu waliona kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake alikuwa pamoja naye.
sw.R: Aliwaita pamoja watu wote wa Yuda na Benyamini, pamoja na watu wa Efraimu, Manase na Simeoni waliokuwa wamekuja kuishi kati yao. Watu wengi sana walikuwa wameiacha Israeli na kuja kwa Asa, kwa sababu waliona kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake alikuwa pamoja naye.

vi.L: Ông tập hợp cả Giu-đa và Bên-gia-min, cùng những người từ Ép-ra-im, Ma-na-se và Si-mê-ôn đang kiều ngụ với họ, vì từ Y-sơ-ra-ên rất nhiều người đã ngả về với ông, khi họ thấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông [ở] với ông.
vi.B: Vua tập hợp cả Giu-đa và Bên-gia-min, cùng những người từ Ép-ra-im, Ma-na-se và Si-mê-ôn đang sống giữa họ như người ngoại kiều. Rất nhiều người từ Y-sơ-ra-ên đã bỏ sang theo vua, vì thấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của vua ở với vua.
vi.R: Vua gọi toàn dân Giu-đa và Bên-gia-min đến, cùng với những người từ Ép-ra-im, Ma-na-se và Si-mê-ôn đã đến sống giữa họ. Rất nhiều người đã bỏ Y-sơ-ra-ên mà sang theo A-sa, vì họ thấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của vua ở với vua.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 온 유다와 베냐민, 그리고 그들 가운데 머물던 에브라임과 므낫세와 시므온 사람들을 모았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 그의 하나님께서 그와 함께 계신 것을 보고 이스라엘에서 많은 사람이 그에게 넘어왔기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그는 온 유다와 베냐민 백성과, 그들 가운데 나그네로 살던 에브라임과 므낫세와 시므온 사람들을 불러 모았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 그의 하나님께서 그와 함께 계신 것을 보고, 이스라엘에서 많은 사람이 그에게 넘어왔기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그는 유다와 베냐민의 모든 백성을 불러 모았다. 그리고 그들 가운데 와서 살던 에브라임과 므낫세와 시므온 사람들도 불러 모았다. 많은 사람이 이스라엘을 떠나 아사에게 넘어와 있었다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 그의 하나님께서 그와 함께 계신 것을 보았기 때문이다.

pt.L: E ele reuniu todo o Judá e Benjamim, e os que viviam como estrangeiros com eles, de Efraim, e de Manassés, e de Simeão, pois tinham passado para ele, vindos de Israel, em grande número, quando viram que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus, [estava] com ele.
pt.B: Ele reuniu todo o Judá e Benjamim, e as pessoas de Efraim, Manassés e Simeão que viviam entre eles como estrangeiros. Muitos de Israel tinham passado para o lado dele, porque viram que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus, estava com ele.
pt.R: Ele chamou todo o povo de Judá e de Benjamim, e também as pessoas de Efraim, Manassés e Simeão que tinham vindo morar entre eles. Muita gente tinha saído de Israel e passado para o lado de Asa, porque viu que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus, estava com ele.

decisions.choice: those sojourning with them: people from the north living in Judah
decisions.reason: The verb means to live as an outsider in a place that is not one's home tribe or land. These were Israelites from the northern tribes who had settled in Judah, as the priests and Levites had done under Rehoboam (11:13-17).

decisions.choice: they had fallen to him: they had gone over to his side
decisions.reason: To "fall to" someone is to desert to him (1 Samuel 29:3; 2 Kings 25:11). They left the northern kingdom for Judah.

decisions.choice: Simeon: a tribe whose land lay inside Judah's
decisions.reason: Simeon's towns were in the far south, within Judah's territory (Joshua 19:1-9). That people of Simeon came "from Israel" may mean some Simeonites had settled in the north, or that Simeon was counted among the northern tribes after the kingdom divided.

decisions.choice: Yahweh his God was with him
decisions.reason: What drew them is the truth of verse 2: Yahweh was with Asa, as his victory over Zerah showed (14:8-14).

decisions.choice: living among them as outsiders (Balanced); had come to live among them (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "sojourning", the verb related to the noun "sojourner"; Balanced uses "outsiders" as for that noun in these books. Readable breaks the long sentence and names Asa for "him".

decisions.choice: "forasteros"
decisions.reason: These were Israelites of other tribes living in Judah (meaning decision); "forasteros" says they were outsiders to the place, not foreigners.

decisions.choice: "kiều ngụ" (L); "sống ... như người ngoại kiều" (B)
decisions.reason: The verb related to the noun "kiều dân" / "người ngoại kiều" of 2:16, kept apart from "foreigner".

decisions.choice: os que viviam como estrangeiros (L, B); que tinham vindo morar (R); passar para o lado dele
decisions.reason: The verb belongs with the noun the Old Testament renders "estrangeiro" (m1), so Literal and Balanced say "viver como estrangeiros"; Portuguese has no everyday verb like "sojourn". "Passar para o lado de" is the Portuguese idiom for deserting to someone (m2).

source.text: וַיִּקָּבְצ֥וּ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י לִשְׁנַ֥ת חֲמֵשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה לְמַלְכ֥וּת אָסָֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: And they gathered [at] Jerusalem in the month the third of [the] year fifteen of [the] reign of Asa.

en.L: And they gathered [at] Jerusalem in the third month of the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.
en.B: They assembled at Jerusalem in the third month of Asa's fifteenth year as king.
en.R: They gathered in Jerusalem in the third month of the fifteenth year that Asa was king.

sw.L: Wakakusanyika Yerusalemu katika mwezi wa tatu wa mwaka wa kumi na tano wa kutawala kwake Asa.
sw.B: Walikusanyika Yerusalemu katika mwezi wa tatu wa mwaka wa kumi na tano wa utawala wa Asa.
sw.R: Walikusanyika Yerusalemu katika mwezi wa tatu wa mwaka wa kumi na tano tangu Asa alipoanza kutawala.

vi.L: Họ tụ họp [tại] Giê-ru-sa-lem vào tháng thứ ba, năm thứ mười lăm triều A-sa.
vi.B: Họ nhóm họp tại Giê-ru-sa-lem vào tháng thứ ba, năm thứ mười lăm triều đại A-sa.
vi.R: Họ tụ họp tại Giê-ru-sa-lem vào tháng thứ ba, năm thứ mười lăm A-sa làm vua.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 아사의 통치 제15년 셋째 달에 예루살렘에 모였다.
ko.B: 그들은 아사가 다스린 지 15년째 되는 해 셋째 달에 예루살렘에 모였다.
ko.R: 그들은 아사가 왕이 된 지 15년째 되는 해의 셋째 달에 예루살렘에 모였다.

pt.L: E eles se reuniram [em] Jerusalém no terceiro mês do décimo quinto ano do reinado de Asa.
pt.B: Eles se reuniram em Jerusalém no terceiro mês do décimo quinto ano do reinado de Asa.
pt.R: Eles se reuniram em Jerusalém no terceiro mês do décimo quinto ano em que Asa era rei.

decisions.choice: the third month: late spring, the time of the Festival of Weeks
decisions.reason: The third month (later called Sivan) fell in May and June, at the end of the grain harvest. The Festival of Weeks was kept then (Exodus 23:16; Leviticus 23:15-21). The festival's name and the "oath" of verses 14-15 sound alike in Hebrew, and the gathering may have been timed for the festival, but the text does not say so.

decisions.choice: the fifteenth year of Asa's reign
decisions.reason: Asa had ten quiet years at the start of his reign (13:23), and then defeated Zerah (14:8-14). The assembly comes soon after that victory, with the plunder still at hand (verse 11).

decisions.choice: the fifteenth year that Asa was king
decisions.reason: Readable says "that Asa was king" for "of the reign of Asa", as with the other dates in these books.

decisions.choice: o décimo quinto ano em que Asa era rei
decisions.reason: Readable dates the reign as 1 Kings 15:9 does in Portuguese ("no vigésimo ano em que Jeroboão era rei"), and so in verse 19.

en.L: And they sacrificed to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} on that day from the plunder [that] they had brought: 700 cattle and 7,000 sheep.
en.B: On that day they sacrificed to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} from the plunder they had brought back: 700 cattle and 7,000 sheep.
en.R: That day they offered sacrifices to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} from the animals they had captured and brought back: 700 cattle and 7,000 sheep and goats.

es.L: Y ofrecieron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} aquel día, del botín que habían traído, setecientos bueyes y siete mil ovejas.
es.B: Aquel día ofrecieron en sacrificio {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, del botín que habían traído, setecientos bueyes y siete mil ovejas.
es.R: Aquel día ofrecieron sacrificios {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} con los animales que habían capturado y traído: setecientos bueyes y siete mil ovejas y cabras.

fr.L: Et ils sacrifièrent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} en ce jour-là, du butin [qu’]ils avaient amené : 700 bœufs et 7 000 moutons.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, ils offrirent en sacrifice {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, sur le butin qu’ils avaient ramené, 700 bœufs et 7 000 moutons.
fr.R: Ce jour-là, ils ont offert en sacrifice {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} une partie des animaux qu’ils avaient pris et ramenés : 700 bœufs et 7 000 moutons et chèvres.

sw.L: Wakamtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} dhabihu siku ile kutoka katika nyara walizoleta: ng'ombe 700 na kondoo 7,000.
sw.B: Siku ile walimtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} dhabihu kutoka katika nyara walizoleta: ng'ombe 700 na kondoo 7,000.
sw.R: Siku ile walimtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} dhabihu kutoka katika wanyama waliowateka na kuwaleta: ng'ombe 700 na kondoo na mbuzi 7,000.

vi.L: Ngày ấy họ dâng sinh tế cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} từ chiến lợi phẩm [mà] họ đã đem về: 700 con bò và 7.000 con chiên.
vi.B: Ngày ấy họ dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} một phần chiến lợi phẩm họ đã đem về: 700 con bò và 7.000 con chiên.
vi.R: Ngày ấy họ dâng sinh tế lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bằng những con vật họ đã bắt được và đem về: 700 con bò và 7.000 con chiên và dê.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그날 그들이 가져온 전리품 가운데서 소 700마리와 양 7천 마리를 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 제물로 바쳤다.
ko.B: 그날 그들은 가져온 전리품 가운데서 소 700마리와 양 7천 마리를 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 제물로 바쳤다.
ko.R: 그날 그들은 전쟁에서 빼앗아 온 짐승 가운데서 소 700마리와 양과 염소 7천 마리를 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 제물로 바쳤다.

pt.L: E sacrificaram {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} naquele dia, do despojo [que] tinham trazido: setecentos bois e sete mil ovelhas.
pt.B: Naquele dia, ofereceram sacrifícios {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} do despojo que tinham trazido: setecentos bois e sete mil ovelhas.
pt.R: Naquele dia, ofereceram sacrifícios {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} com os animais que tinham capturado e trazido: setecentos bois e sete mil ovelhas e cabras.

decisions.choice: the plunder they had brought: the livestock taken in the war with Zerah
decisions.reason: After the victory over Zerah the Cushite, Judah carried off sheep, goats and camels in great numbers from the land around Gerar (14:12-14). Part of it is now given back to Yahweh, who had won the battle.

decisions.choice: sheep: the word covers sheep and goats
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means a flock of small animals, sheep and goats together.

decisions.choice: the animals they had captured; sheep and goats
decisions.reason: Readable says what the plunder was (m1) and names both kinds of animal in the flock (m2).

decisions.choice: setecentos bois e sete mil ovelhas
decisions.reason: Round numbers are written in words, as the style sets for these books, where the English uses figures.

records.literal_gloss: And they entered into [the] covenant to seek Yahweh God of their fathers with all their heart and with all their soul,

en.B: They entered into the covenant: they would seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of their ancestors, with all their heart and with all their soul,
en.R: They made a covenant to seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of their ancestors, with all their heart and with all their being.

es.L: E hicieron pacto de buscar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios de sus padres, con todo su corazón y con toda su alma,
es.B: Hicieron un pacto: buscarían {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios de sus antepasados, con todo su corazón y con toda su alma,
es.R: Hicieron un pacto de buscar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios de sus antepasados, con todo su corazón y con todo su ser.

fr.B: Ils entrèrent dans l’alliance : ils rechercheraient {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu de leurs ancêtres, de tout leur cœur et de toute leur âme,
fr.R: Ils ont pris l’engagement solennel de chercher {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu de leurs ancêtres, de tout leur cœur et de tout leur être.

sw.L: Wakaingia katika agano la kumtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wa baba zao kwa moyo wao wote na kwa nafsi yao yote,
sw.B: Waliingia katika agano: wangemtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa babu zao, kwa moyo wao wote na kwa roho yao yote,
sw.R: Walifanya agano la kumtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa babu zao, kwa moyo wao wote na kwa nafsi yao yote.

vi.L: Họ lập giao ước tìm cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ phụ họ, hết lòng và hết linh hồn,
vi.B: Họ lập giao ước rằng họ sẽ tìm cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên họ, hết lòng và hết linh hồn,
vi.R: Họ lập giao ước sẽ hết lòng và hết cả con người mình tìm cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên họ.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 온 마음과 온 영혼으로 그들 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾기로 언약을 맺었다.
ko.B: 그들은 온 마음과 온 영혼으로 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾겠다고 언약을 맺었다.
ko.R: 그들은 마음과 정성을 다해 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾겠다고 언약을 맺었다.

pt.L: E entraram na aliança de buscar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus dos seus pais, de todo o seu coração e de toda a sua alma,
pt.B: Eles entraram na aliança: buscariam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus dos seus antepassados, de todo o seu coração e de toda a sua alma,
pt.R: Eles fizeram uma aliança de buscar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus dos seus antepassados, de todo o coração e com todo o seu ser.

decisions.choice: entered into a covenant: bound themselves by solemn agreement
decisions.reason: To "enter into" a covenant is to take it on oneself with its promises and penalties (Deuteronomy 29:11; Jeremiah 34:10). This is not a new covenant with Yahweh but a renewal of the people's commitment to the one he made with Israel. The article may point to that covenant: "the covenant".

decisions.choice: seek Yahweh: turn to him, worship him and ask his will
decisions.reason: To seek Yahweh in Chronicles is to make him the one God served, worshiped and asked for help, as against other gods (1 Chronicles 10:13-14; 2 Chronicles 14:3). It is the key word of Azariah's message (verse 2).

decisions.choice: with all their heart and with all their soul
decisions.reason: The words of Deuteronomy 4:29, where Moses promised that Israel would find Yahweh when they sought him with all their heart and all their soul, and of the great command to love him so (Deuteronomy 6:5). Heart and soul together mean the whole person.

decisions.choice: ancestors; being (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "ancestors" for "fathers". Readable says "being" for "soul" as at Deuteronomy 4:29, since the Hebrew means the whole self. The sentence goes on in verse 13; Literal and Balanced end this verse with a comma, and Readable starts a new sentence.

decisions.choice: de todo o seu coração e de toda a sua alma (L, B); de todo o coração e com todo o seu ser (R)
alternatives: com todo o coração e com toda a alma
decisions.reason: The words of Deuteronomy 4:29 (m3), in the wording that verse sets in Portuguese, "de todo o teu coração e de toda a tua alma", with Readable's "com todo o teu ser", turned to the third person plural. "Buscar" as in verse 2; "os seus pais" (L) and "os seus antepassados" (B, R) as the death formula of Kings.

records.literal_gloss: and every [one] who not will seek Yahweh God of Israel will be put to death, from small to great, from man to woman.

en.L: and every [one] who would not seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the God of Israel would be put to death, from small to great, from man to woman.
en.B: and anyone, young or old, man or woman, who refused to seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, would be put to death.
en.R: Anyone who would not seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, was to be put to death, whether young or old, man or woman.

es.L: y que cualquiera que no buscara {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, muriera, desde el pequeño hasta el grande, desde el hombre hasta la mujer.
es.B: y que cualquiera, joven o viejo, hombre o mujer, que se negara a buscar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, sería condenado a muerte.
es.R: Cualquiera que no buscara {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, debía morir, fuera joven o viejo, hombre o mujer.

fr.L: et quiconque ne rechercherait pas {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, serait mis à mort, du petit au grand, de l’homme à la femme.
fr.B: et quiconque, petit ou grand, homme ou femme, refuserait de rechercher {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, serait mis à mort.
fr.R: Toute personne qui refuserait de chercher {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, devait être mise à mort, qu’elle soit jeune ou vieille, homme ou femme.

sw.L: na kila ambaye hatamtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wa Israeli angeuawa, tangu mdogo hadi mkubwa, tangu mwanamume hadi mwanamke.
sw.B: na yeyote, mdogo au mkubwa, mwanamume au mwanamke, ambaye angekataa kumtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, angeuawa.
sw.R: Yeyote ambaye hangemtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, angeuawa, awe mdogo au mkubwa, mwanamume au mwanamke.

vi.L: và hễ ai không tìm cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, sẽ bị xử tử, từ nhỏ đến lớn, từ đàn ông đến đàn bà.
vi.B: và bất cứ ai, dù nhỏ hay lớn, đàn ông hay đàn bà, không chịu tìm cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, sẽ bị xử tử.
vi.R: Ai không tìm cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, sẽ phải bị xử tử, dù già hay trẻ, đàn ông hay đàn bà.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾지 않는 사람은 누구든지 작은 자부터 큰 자까지, 남자부터 여자까지 죽임을 당할 것이었다.
ko.B: 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾지 않는 사람은 젊은이든 늙은이든, 남자든 여자든 누구나 죽임을 당하기로 했다.
ko.R: 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾지 않는 사람은 젊은이든 늙은이든, 남자든 여자든 누구나 죽이기로 했다.

pt.L: e todo aquele que não buscasse {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, seria morto, do pequeno ao grande, do homem à mulher.
pt.B: e qualquer um, jovem ou velho, homem ou mulher, que se recusasse a buscar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, seria morto.
pt.R: Quem não buscasse {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, seria morto, fosse jovem ou velho, homem ou mulher.

decisions.choice: whoever would not seek Yahweh would be put to death
decisions.reason: The covenant takes up the law against turning to other gods, which named death for anyone who did so, whether a family member, a whole town, or any man or woman (Exodus 22:19; Deuteronomy 13:7-12; 17:2-7). Not seeking Yahweh here means refusing him for other gods, not lacking zeal.

decisions.choice: from small to great, from man to woman: everyone without exception
decisions.reason: Two pairs of opposites take in the whole people: young and old (or low and high) and men and women. No one is exempt.

decisions.choice: and anyone, young or old, man or woman, who refused to seek
decisions.reason: Balanced carries on the sentence from verse 12, where the colon introduces what the covenant said, and moves the pairs of opposites forward so that the sentence ends on its main point. "Refused to seek" says "would not seek" as a choice, which is the sense (m1).

decisions.choice: young or old
decisions.reason: "Small" and "great" can mean young and old or humble and important; Balanced and Readable say "young or old", the usual sense when set beside "man or woman".

source.text: וַיִּשָּֽׁבְעוּ֙ לַיהוָ֔ה בְּק֥וֹל גָּד֖וֹל וּבִתְרוּעָ֑ה וּבַחֲצֹצְר֖וֹת וּבְשׁוֹפָרֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And they swore to Yahweh with a voice loud and with shouting and with trumpets and with horns.

en.L: And they swore to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with horns.
en.B: They swore an oath to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with a loud voice, with shouts of joy, and with trumpets and rams' horns.
en.R: They made their promise to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with loud voices. They shouted for joy and blew trumpets and rams' horns.

es.L: Y juraron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en alta voz, y con júbilo, y con trompetas, y con cuernos.
es.B: Hicieron juramento {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en alta voz, con gritos de júbilo, con trompetas y con cuernos de carnero.
es.R: Le hicieron su promesa {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en voz alta. Gritaban de alegría y tocaban trompetas y cuernos de carnero.

fr.L: Et ils jurèrent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} à grande voix, et avec des acclamations, et avec des trompettes, et avec des cors.
fr.B: Ils prêtèrent serment {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} à grande voix, avec des cris de joie, au son des trompettes et des cors.
fr.R: Ils ont fait leur promesse {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} d’une voix forte. Ils ont poussé des cris de joie et ils ont sonné des trompettes et des cornes de bélier.

sw.L: Wakamwapia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa sauti kuu, na kwa kelele, na kwa tarumbeta, na kwa pembe.
sw.B: Walimwapia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kiapo kwa sauti kuu, kwa kelele za furaha, na kwa tarumbeta na baragumu za pembe za kondoo.
sw.R: Walimwahidi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa sauti kubwa. Walipiga kelele za furaha, wakapiga tarumbeta na baragumu za pembe za kondoo.

vi.L: Họ thề với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bằng tiếng lớn, với tiếng reo hò, với kèn và tù và.
vi.B: Họ lớn tiếng thề nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, reo hò vui mừng, thổi kèn và tù và.
vi.R: Họ lớn tiếng hứa nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Họ reo hò vui mừng và thổi kèn và tù và.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 큰 소리와 함성과 나팔과 뿔나팔로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 맹세했다.
ko.B: 그들은 큰 소리로 기쁘게 외치며 나팔과 숫양 뿔나팔을 불면서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 맹세했다.
ko.R: 그들은 큰 소리로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 약속했다. 그들은 기뻐서 소리치며 나팔과 숫양 뿔나팔을 불었다.

pt.L: E juraram {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} em alta voz, e com gritos, e com trombetas, e com chifres de carneiro.
pt.B: Fizeram um juramento {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} em alta voz, com gritos de alegria, ao som de trombetas e de chifres de carneiro.
pt.R: Eles fizeram a sua promessa {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} em voz alta. Gritaram de alegria e tocaram trombetas e chifres de carneiro.

decisions.choice: shouting, trumpets and horns: the sounds of a great festival
decisions.reason: The shout could be a war cry or a cry of joy; here, with verse 15, it is joy. The trumpets were the metal trumpets the priests blew at festivals and sacrifices (Numbers 10:2-10; 1 Chronicles 15:24); the horns were rams' horns, used for signals and celebrations, as when the ark was brought up to Jerusalem (1 Chronicles 15:28).

decisions.choice: swore: took a solemn oath
decisions.reason: They bound themselves by oath to keep the covenant of verses 12-13.

decisions.choice: swore an oath; shouts of joy; rams' horns
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "oath" or "promise" as the object of the verb, say what kind of shouting it was (m1), and name the horns as rams' horns.

decisions.choice: "cors" (L, B); "cornes de bélier" (R)
decisions.reason: The shofar as in French Samuel and Kings: "le cor" at Literal and Balanced, "la corne de bélier" at Readable.

decisions.choice: "kèn" for trumpets, "tù và" for the horns
decisions.reason: The two instruments kept apart, as the Samuel drafts: "kèn" for the metal trumpets, "tù và" for the ram's horn (shofar).

decisions.choice: trombetas; chifres de carneiro (every level)
decisions.reason: The metal trumpets of the priests are "trombetas" and the ram's horn is "chifre de carneiro" (m1), the pair kept apart in these books (1 Chronicles 15:28). Literal names the instrument too, though the English Literal says only "horns".

source.text: וַיִּשְׂמְח֨וּ כָל־יְהוּדָ֜ה עַל־הַשְּׁבוּעָ֗ה כִּ֤י בְכָל־לְבָבָם֙ נִשְׁבָּ֔עוּ וּבְכָל־רְצוֹנָ֣ם בִּקְשֻׁ֔הוּ וַיִּמָּצֵ֖א לָהֶ֑ם וַיָּ֧נַח יְהוָ֛ה לָהֶ֖ם מִסָּבִֽיב׃

records.literal_gloss: And rejoiced all Judah over the oath, for with all their heart they had sworn, and with all their will they had sought him, and he was found by them; and gave rest Yahweh to them from around.

en.L: And all Judah rejoiced over the oath, for with all their heart they had sworn, and with all their desire they had sought {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was found by them; and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave them rest from all around.
en.B: All Judah rejoiced over the oath, because they had sworn it with all their heart and had sought {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with all their desire, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} let them find {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave them rest on every side.
en.R: All the people of Judah were glad about the promise, because they had made it with all their heart. They had looked for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with all their desire, and they found {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave them peace on every side.

es.L: Y todo Judá se alegró por el juramento, porque de todo su corazón lo habían jurado, y con toda su voluntad lo habían buscado, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se dejó hallar por ellos; y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} les dio descanso por todas partes.
es.B: Todo Judá se alegró por el juramento, porque lo habían hecho de todo corazón y lo habían buscado con toda su voluntad, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se dejó encontrar por ellos. Así {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} les dio descanso por todos lados.
es.R: Todo el pueblo de Judá se alegró por la promesa, porque la habían hecho de todo corazón. Habían buscado a Dios con todo su deseo, y lo encontraron. Así {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} les dio paz por todos lados.

fr.L: Et tout Juda se réjouit du serment, car ils avaient juré de tout leur cœur, et ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avaient recherché de tout leur désir, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’était laissé trouver par eux ; et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur donna du repos tout autour.
fr.B: Tout Juda se réjouit de ce serment, car ils l’avaient prêté de tout leur cœur et ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avaient recherché de tout leur désir, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’était laissé trouver par eux. Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur donna du repos de tous côtés.
fr.R: Tout le peuple de Juda était heureux de cet engagement, parce qu’ils l’avaient pris de tout leur cœur. Ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avaient cherché de tout leur désir, et ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avaient trouvé. Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur a donné la paix de tous côtés.

sw.L: Yuda wote wakafurahia kiapo hicho, kwa maana waliapa kwa moyo wao wote, na kwa shauku yao yote walimtafuta, naye akaonekana kwao; na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawapa raha pande zote.
sw.B: Yuda wote walifurahia kiapo hicho, kwa sababu walikuwa wameapa kwa moyo wao wote na kumtafuta kwa shauku yao yote, naye akawawezesha kumpata. Hivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawapa raha pande zote.
sw.R: Watu wote wa Yuda walifurahi kwa ajili ya ahadi hiyo, kwa sababu waliifanya kwa moyo wao wote. Walimtafuta kwa shauku yao yote, nao wakampata. Hivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawapa amani pande zote.

vi.L: Cả Giu-đa vui mừng về lời thề ấy, vì họ đã hết lòng thề nguyện, và hết ý muốn tìm cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho họ gặp được; {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban cho họ được yên nghỉ khắp chung quanh.
vi.B: Cả Giu-đa vui mừng về lời thề ấy, vì họ đã hết lòng thề nguyện và hết lòng mong muốn tìm cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cho họ gặp được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban cho họ được yên nghỉ khắp bốn phía.
vi.R: Toàn dân Giu-đa vui mừng về lời hứa nguyện ấy, vì họ đã hết lòng hứa nguyện. Họ đã hết lòng mong muốn tìm kiếm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và họ đã gặp được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho họ được bình yên khắp bốn phía.

ko.L: 그리고 온 유다가 그 맹세를 두고 기뻐했다. 그들이 온 마음으로 맹세했고, 온 소원으로 그분을 찾았으며, 그분께서 그들에게 찾아지셨기 때문이다. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 사방으로 그들에게 안식을 주셨다.
ko.B: 온 유다가 그 맹세를 기뻐했다. 그들이 온 마음으로 맹세했고, 간절한 마음으로 그분을 찾았으며, 그분께서 그들이 그분을 만나게 해 주셨기 때문이다. 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 사방으로 그들에게 안식을 주셨다.
ko.R: 유다의 모든 백성은 그 약속을 기뻐했다. 그들은 온 마음을 다해 약속했고, 간절한 마음으로 그분을 찾았으며, 그분을 만났다. 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 사방으로 그들에게 평안을 주셨다.

pt.L: E todo o Judá se alegrou com o juramento, pois de todo o seu coração tinham jurado, e com toda a sua vontade {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} tinham buscado, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} foi achado por eles; e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhes deu descanso ao redor.
pt.B: Todo o Judá se alegrou com o juramento, porque o tinham feito de todo o coração e {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} tinham buscado com toda a sua vontade, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se deixou achar por eles. Assim {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhes deu descanso por todos os lados.
pt.R: Todo o povo de Judá ficou contente com a promessa, porque a tinha feito de todo o coração. Eles {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} tinham buscado com toda a vontade, e {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} acharam. Por isso {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhes deu paz por todos os lados.

decisions.choice: they had sought him and he was found by them: the promise kept
decisions.reason: The very words of Azariah's promise (verse 2) and of the past (verse 4). Because the people sought Yahweh wholeheartedly, he let them find him.

decisions.choice: with all their desire: with their whole will, gladly
decisions.reason: The word means will, desire or goodwill. With "all their heart" it says that the oath was not forced but freely and gladly taken.

decisions.choice: gave them rest from all around: peace from enemies on every side
decisions.reason: Rest is the peace Yahweh promised when Israel was secure from its enemies (Deuteronomy 12:10; 1 Chronicles 22:9). Chronicles said the same of Asa's early years (14:5-6), and verse 19 tells how long it lasted.

decisions.choice: he let them find him (Balanced); they found him (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verses 2 and 4. Readable says "peace" for "rest" (m3), and "promise" for "oath" as in verse 14.

decisions.choice: buscado ... foi achado (L), se deixou achar (B), acharam (R); descanso (L, B), paz (R)
decisions.reason: The promise of verse 2 kept (m1), in the words of verses 2 and 4 at each level. "Descanso" is the rest from enemies (m3), as the Old Testament's promise of rest has it in Portuguese; Readable says "paz", as the English Readable.

source.text: וְגַֽם־מַעֲכָ֞ה אֵ֣ם׀אָסָ֣א הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ הֱסִירָהּ֙ מִגְּבִירָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־עָשְׂתָ֥ה לַאֲשֵׁרָ֖ה מִפְלָ֑צֶת וַיִּכְרֹ֤ת אָסָא֙ אֶת־מִפְלַצְתָּ֔הּ וַיָּ֕דֶק וַיִּשְׂרֹ֖ף בְּנַ֥חַל קִדְרֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And also Maacah [the] mother of Asa the king, he removed her from [being] queen mother, because she had made for Asherah a horrid thing; and cut down Asa her horrid thing and crushed and burned [it] in [the] valley of Kidron.

en.L: And also Maacah, the mother of Asa the king: he removed her from [being] queen mother, because she had made a horrid thing for Asherah; and Asa cut down her horrid thing and crushed [it] and burned [it] in the valley of Kidron.
en.B: King Asa even deposed his mother Maacah as queen mother, because she had made a horrid image for Asherah. Asa cut down her image, crushed it and burned it in the Kidron Valley.
en.R: King Asa even took away the title of queen mother from Maacah, his mother, because she had made a disgusting idol to worship the goddess Asherah. Asa cut the idol down, crushed it and burned it in the Kidron Valley.

es.L: Y también a Maaca, madre del rey Asá, la quitó de [ser] reina madre, porque había hecho una cosa horrible para Aserá; y Asá cortó su cosa horrible, y [la] desmenuzó y [la] quemó en el valle del Cedrón.
es.B: Incluso destituyó el rey Asá a su madre Maaca como reina madre, porque había hecho una imagen horrible para Aserá. Asá cortó la imagen, la hizo pedazos y la quemó en el valle del Cedrón.
es.R: El rey Asá hasta le quitó el título de reina madre a Maaca, su madre, porque había hecho un ídolo repugnante para adorar a la diosa Aserá. Asá derribó el ídolo, lo hizo pedazos y lo quemó en el valle del Cedrón.

fr.L: Et même Maaka, mère du roi Asa, il l’écarta de [la dignité de] reine mère, parce qu’elle avait fait une horreur pour Ashéra ; et Asa abattit son horreur, la broya et [la] brûla dans la vallée du Cédron.
fr.B: Le roi Asa destitua même sa mère Maaka de sa dignité de reine mère, parce qu’elle avait fait une image horrible pour Ashéra. Asa abattit cette image, la broya et la brûla dans la vallée du Cédron.
fr.R: Le roi Asa a même enlevé à Maaka, sa mère, son titre de reine mère, parce qu’elle avait fait une idole répugnante pour adorer la déesse Ashéra. Asa a abattu cette idole, il l’a réduite en poussière et il l’a brûlée dans la vallée du Cédron.

sw.L: Tena Maaka, mama yake Asa mfalme, akamwondoa katika [cheo cha] mama wa mfalme, kwa sababu alikuwa ametengeneza kitu cha kuchukiza kwa ajili ya Ashera; Asa akakikata kitu chake cha kuchukiza, akakiponda, akakiteketeza katika bonde la Kidroni.
sw.B: Mfalme Asa hata alimwondoa Maaka mama yake katika cheo cha mama wa mfalme, kwa sababu alikuwa ametengeneza sanamu ya kuchukiza kwa ajili ya Ashera. Asa akaikata sanamu yake, akaiponda, akaiteketeza katika Bonde la Kidroni.
sw.R: Mfalme Asa hata alimnyang'anya Maaka, mama yake, cheo cha mama wa mfalme, kwa sababu alikuwa ametengeneza sanamu ya kuchukiza ili kumwabudu mungu wa kike Ashera. Asa akaikata sanamu hiyo, akaiponda, akaichoma katika Bonde la Kidroni.

vi.L: Ngay cả Ma-a-ca, mẹ của vua A-sa, vua cũng truất khỏi [ngôi] thái hậu, vì bà đã làm một vật gớm ghiếc cho A-sê-ra; A-sa chặt bỏ vật gớm ghiếc của bà, nghiền nát và đốt [nó] trong thung lũng Xết-rôn.
vi.B: Vua A-sa còn truất ngôi thái hậu của Ma-a-ca, mẹ mình, vì bà đã làm một tượng gớm ghiếc cho A-sê-ra. A-sa chặt bỏ tượng ấy, nghiền nát và đốt nó trong thung lũng Xết-rôn.
vi.R: Vua A-sa còn lấy đi danh vị thái hậu của Ma-a-ca, mẹ mình, vì bà đã làm một thần tượng ghê tởm để thờ nữ thần A-sê-ra. A-sa chặt bỏ thần tượng ấy, nghiền nát và đốt nó trong thung lũng Xết-rôn.

ko.L: 그리고 아사 왕의 어머니 마아가도 그가 대비[의 자리]에서 물러나게 했다. 그 여자가 아세라를 위해 끔찍한 것을 만들었기 때문이다. 아사는 그 여자의 끔찍한 것을 찍어 부수고 기드론 골짜기에서 불살랐다.
ko.B: 아사 왕은 자기 어머니 마아가까지 대비 자리에서 물러나게 했다. 그 여자가 아세라를 위해 끔찍한 상을 만들었기 때문이다. 아사는 그 상을 찍어 부수고 기드론 골짜기에서 불살랐다.
ko.R: 아사 왕은 자기 어머니 마아가에게서 대비의 지위까지 빼앗았다. 그 여자가 아세라 여신을 섬기려고 역겨운 우상을 만들었기 때문이다. 아사는 그 우상을 찍어 넘어뜨리고 부순 다음 기드론 골짜기에서 불태웠다.

pt.L: E também Maaca, a mãe de Asa, o rei, ele a removeu de [ser] rainha-mãe, porque ela tinha feito uma coisa horrenda para Aserá; e Asa cortou a coisa horrenda dela, e [a] triturou, e [a] queimou no vale do Cedrom.
pt.B: O rei Asa chegou a tirar de sua mãe Maaca a posição de rainha-mãe, porque ela tinha feito uma imagem horrenda para Aserá. Asa cortou a imagem, triturou-a e a queimou no vale do Cedrom.
pt.R: O rei Asa até tirou de Maaca, sua mãe, o título de rainha-mãe, porque ela tinha feito um ídolo nojento para adorar a deusa Aserá. Asa cortou o ídolo, quebrou-o em pedaços e o queimou no vale do Cedrom.

decisions.choice: the same account as 1 Kings 15:13, with two differences
decisions.reason: Verses 16-18 repeat 1 Kings 15:13-15 almost word for word. Here Maacah is "the mother of Asa the king" where Kings has "his mother", and Asa "crushed" the object before burning it, a word Kings does not have.

decisions.choice: mother: probably his grandmother, who stayed queen mother
decisions.reason: Maacah was the wife of Rehoboam and the mother of Abijah, Asa's father (11:20-22). "Mother" here most likely means grandmother, who kept her place as queen mother into Asa's reign. Chronicles names Abijah's mother as Micaiah daughter of Uriel at 13:2, which may be another form of her name.

decisions.choice: queen mother: an office at the royal court
decisions.reason: The word means "great lady". The king's mother held a recognized place of honor and influence (1 Kings 2:19; Jeremiah 13:18). Asa took that position away from Maacah, as 1 Kings 15:13 explains.

decisions.choice: a horrid thing for Asherah: an object of worship meant to cause horror
decisions.reason: The word comes from a root meaning to shudder, and it is found only here and in 1 Kings 15:13. What it looked like is not known; that it was cut down suggests wood, or a pole. Asherah was a Canaanite goddess, and the same word names the wooden poles set up for her, but "for Asherah" points to the goddess.

decisions.choice: the valley of Kidron: the valley on the east side of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: A stream bed east of the city that runs only in the rainy season. Kings who cleansed Judah of idols destroyed them there (29:16; 30:14; 2 Kings 23:4, 6).

decisions.choice: horrid image (Balanced); disgusting idol (Readable)
decisions.reason: As at 1 Kings 15:13. Literal keeps "horrid thing"; Readable says who Asherah was (m4). Balanced and Readable move "King Asa" to the front of the sentence.

decisions.choice: wording of 1 Kings 15:13 kept, with "desmenuzó", "hizo pedazos"
decisions.reason: Verses 16-18 repeat 1 Kings 15:13-15 (meaning decision); the Spanish Kings wording is kept at each level, with "crushed it" added where Chronicles adds it.

decisions.choice: the wording of 1 Kings 15:13, with "nghiền nát" added
decisions.reason: Chronicles adds that Asa crushed the image (m1); "thái hậu" and "vật gớm ghiếc" are kept from Kings.

decisions.choice: The wording of 1 Kings 15:13-15 in verses 16-18; "대비" for the queen mother; "부수고" added where Chronicles adds "crushed"
decisions.reason: Verses 16-18 repeat 1 Kings 15:13-15 with small differences (m1); Korean follows Kings and changes only those words.

decisions.choice: the wording of 1 Kings 15:13, with "a mãe de Asa, o rei" (L) and "triturou" (L, B), "quebrou em pedaços" (R)
decisions.reason: Verses 16-18 repeat 1 Kings 15:13-15 (m1), so each level keeps the Portuguese of 1 Kings ("Maaca", "rainha-mãe", "uma coisa horrenda" / "uma imagem horrenda" / "um ídolo nojento", "Aserá", "o vale do Cedrom"), changing only what Chronicles changes: Literal names Maacah "a mãe de Asa, o rei", and every level adds the crushing before the burning.
