records.literal_gloss: And the high places not were removed from Israel; only [the] heart of Asa was whole all his days.

en.L: But the high places were not removed from Israel; only, the heart of Asa was whole all his days.
en.B: The high places, however, were not taken away from Israel. Even so, Asa's heart was undivided all his life.
en.R: But the hilltop shrines were not removed from Israel. Even so, Asa was completely loyal to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} all his life.

es.L: Pero los lugares altos no fueron quitados de Israel; con todo, el corazón de Asá fue íntegro todos sus días.
es.B: Sin embargo, los lugares altos no fueron quitados de Israel. Aun así, el corazón de Asá fue íntegro toda su vida.
es.R: Pero los santuarios sobre las colinas no fueron quitados de Israel. Aun así, Asá fue completamente leal {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} toda su vida.

fr.L: Mais les hauts lieux ne furent pas supprimés d’Israël ; seulement, le cœur d’Asa fut entier tous ses jours.
fr.B: Les hauts lieux, cependant, ne disparurent pas d’Israël. Malgré cela, le cœur d’Asa fut sans partage toute sa vie.
fr.R: Mais les sanctuaires sur les collines n’ont pas été supprimés d’Israël. Malgré cela, Asa a été entièrement fidèle {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} toute sa vie.

sw.L: Lakini mahali pa juu hapakuondolewa katika Israeli; ila moyo wa Asa ulikuwa mkamilifu siku zake zote.
sw.B: Hata hivyo, mahali pa juu hapakuondolewa katika Israeli. Lakini moyo wa Asa ulijitoa kikamilifu maisha yake yote.
sw.R: Lakini patakatifu pa kilimani hapakuondolewa katika Israeli. Hata hivyo, Asa alikuwa mwaminifu kabisa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} maisha yake yote.

vi.L: Nhưng các nơi cao không bị dẹp bỏ khỏi Y-sơ-ra-ên; dù vậy, lòng A-sa trọn vẹn trọn đời ông.
vi.B: Tuy nhiên, các nơi cao không bị dẹp bỏ khỏi Y-sơ-ra-ên. Dù vậy, lòng A-sa trọn vẹn suốt đời vua.
vi.R: Nhưng các nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao không bị dẹp bỏ khỏi Y-sơ-ra-ên. Dù vậy, A-sa vẫn hết lòng trung thành với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} suốt đời mình.

ko.L: 그러나 산당들은 이스라엘에서 없어지지 않았다. 다만 아사의 마음은 그의 평생 동안 온전했다.
ko.B: 그러나 산당들은 이스라엘에서 없어지지 않았다. 그래도 아사의 마음은 평생 온전했다.
ko.R: 그러나 산꼭대기 제단들은 이스라엘에서 없어지지 않았다. 그래도 아사는 평생 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 온전히 충성했다.

pt.L: Mas os altos não foram removidos de Israel; só que o coração de Asa foi íntegro todos os seus dias.
pt.B: Os altos, porém, não foram removidos de Israel. Mesmo assim, o coração de Asa foi íntegro durante toda a sua vida.
pt.R: Mas os santuários no alto dos morros não foram removidos de Israel. Mesmo assim, Asa foi totalmente fiel {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} durante toda a sua vida.

decisions.choice: the same verdict as 1 Kings 15:14, with two differences
decisions.reason: Kings says the high places were not removed, and that Asa's heart was whole "with Yahweh". Chronicles adds "from Israel" and leaves out "with Yahweh", though his loyalty to Yahweh is still the point.

decisions.choice: from Israel: perhaps the northern territory Asa held
decisions.reason: Chronicles has said that Asa removed the high places from the towns of Judah (14:2, 4). "From Israel" may mean the towns he had taken from the northern kingdom (verse 8), so the two statements agree; or "Israel" may mean the whole people, and the earlier removal was not complete.

decisions.choice: his heart was whole: his loyalty was undivided
decisions.reason: A whole or complete heart is one given without reserve, as in 1 Chronicles 28:9. Though the high places stayed, Asa himself served Yahweh with an undivided heart.

decisions.choice: high places (Literal, Balanced); hilltop shrines (Readable); Even so
decisions.reason: The wording kept for these words in these books, as at 1 Kings 15:14. Balanced says "undivided", since Chronicles does not have "with Yahweh" here.

decisions.choice: completely loyal to the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable names the one Asa was loyal to, which the sentence leaves to be understood (m1).

decisions.choice: "les hauts lieux ne furent pas supprimés" (L); "ne disparurent pas" (B)
decisions.reason: The high-places formula of the terms note, as in French Kings (1 Kings 15:14).

decisions.choice: os altos (L, B), os santuários no alto dos morros (R); o coração de Asa foi íntegro (L, B)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 15:14 in Portuguese, with "de Israel" added and "para com o SENHOR" left out, as Chronicles has it (m1); Balanced therefore says "íntegro", which stands without an object, where Kings says "inteiramente dedicado ao SENHOR". Readable keeps Kings' sentence, naming the LORD, as the English Readable does.

records.literal_gloss: And he brought [the] holy things of his father and his holy things [into the] house of the God: silver and gold and vessels.

en.L: And he brought the holy things of his father and his holy things [into] the house of God: silver and gold and vessels.
en.B: He brought into the house of God the gifts his father had dedicated and the gifts he himself had dedicated: silver, gold and utensils.
en.R: He brought into God's temple the gifts of silver and gold and other objects that his father and he himself had dedicated to God.

es.L: Y trajo las cosas consagradas de su padre y sus cosas consagradas [a la] casa de Dios: plata, oro y utensilios.
es.B: Llevó a la casa de Dios las ofrendas que su padre había consagrado y las que él mismo había consagrado: plata, oro y utensilios.
es.R: Llevó al templo de Dios las ofrendas de plata y oro y otros objetos que su padre y él mismo habían apartado para Dios.

fr.L: Et il apporta les choses saintes de son père et ses choses saintes [dans la] maison de Dieu : argent, or et ustensiles.
fr.B: Il apporta dans la maison de Dieu les offrandes consacrées par son père et celles qu’il avait consacrées lui-même : de l’argent, de l’or et des ustensiles.
fr.R: Il a apporté au temple de Dieu les objets d’argent, d’or et les autres objets que son père et lui-même avaient consacrés à Dieu.

sw.L: Akaleta vitu vitakatifu vya baba yake na vitu vyake vitakatifu [ndani ya] nyumba ya Mungu: fedha na dhahabu na vyombo.
sw.B: Akaleta ndani ya nyumba ya Mungu vitu ambavyo baba yake alikuwa ameviweka wakfu na vitu ambavyo yeye mwenyewe aliviweka wakfu: fedha, dhahabu na vyombo.
sw.R: Akaleta ndani ya hekalu la Mungu zawadi za fedha na dhahabu na vitu vingine ambavyo baba yake na yeye mwenyewe walikuwa wamevitenga kwa ajili ya Mungu.

vi.L: Ông đem các vật thánh của cha ông và các vật thánh của ông [vào] nhà Đức Chúa Trời: bạc, vàng và các vật dụng.
vi.B: Vua đem vào nhà Đức Chúa Trời các lễ vật cha vua đã biệt riêng ra thánh và các lễ vật chính vua đã biệt riêng ra thánh: bạc, vàng và các vật dụng.
vi.R: Vua đem vào đền thờ của Đức Chúa Trời các lễ vật bằng bạc, vàng và các vật dụng khác mà cha vua và chính vua đã biệt riêng ra cho Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그의 아버지의 거룩한 것들과 그의 거룩한 것들, 곧 은과 금과 그릇들을 하나님의 집에 들여놓았다.
ko.B: 그는 그의 아버지가 바친 예물과 자기가 바친 예물, 곧 은과 금과 기구들을 하나님의 집에 들여놓았다.
ko.R: 그는 그의 아버지와 자기가 하나님께 바치려고 따로 떼어 둔 은과 금과 여러 물건을 하나님의 성전에 들여놓았다.

pt.L: E ele trouxe as coisas santas do seu pai e as suas coisas santas [para a] casa de Deus: prata, e ouro, e utensílios.
pt.B: Ele trouxe para a casa de Deus as ofertas que o seu pai tinha consagrado e as que ele mesmo tinha consagrado: prata, ouro e utensílios.
pt.R: Ele levou para o templo de Deus as ofertas de prata e ouro e outros objetos que o seu pai e ele mesmo tinham separado para Deus.

decisions.choice: the same as 1 Kings 15:15, with "God" for "Yahweh"
decisions.reason: Kings has "the house of Yahweh"; Chronicles says "the house of God". Here the Hebrew plainly reads "his holy things", Asa's own gifts, the reading followed at 1 Kings 15:15.

decisions.choice: holy things: gifts dedicated to God
decisions.reason: Things declared holy belonged to God and were kept in the temple treasuries, often silver and gold taken in war (1 Chronicles 18:11; 26:26-27). Abijah's may have come from his war with Jeroboam (13:16-19), Asa's from the war with Zerah (14:12-14).

decisions.choice: [into]
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has no preposition: the house is the place the gifts were brought to.

decisions.choice: God's temple; dedicated to God
decisions.reason: Readable calls the house of God the temple and explains "holy things" as dedicated gifts (m2).

decisions.choice: the wording of 1 Kings 15:15, with "de Deus"
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 15:15 in Portuguese at each level, with "a casa de Deus" (L, B) and "o templo de Deus" (R) where Kings has the divine name (m1).

en.B: There was no war until the thirty-fifth year of the reign of Asa.
en.R: There was no more war until the thirty-fifth year that Asa was king.

es.L: Y no hubo guerra hasta el año treinta y cinco del reinado de Asá.
es.B: No hubo guerra hasta el año treinta y cinco del reinado de Asá.
es.R: No hubo más guerra hasta el año treinta y cinco del reinado de Asá.

fr.L: Et il n’y eut pas de guerre jusqu’à la trente-cinquième année du règne d’Asa.
fr.B: Il n’y eut pas de guerre jusqu’à la trente-cinquième année du règne d’Asa.
fr.R: Il n’y a plus eu de guerre jusqu’à la trente-cinquième année du règne d’Asa.

sw.L: Wala hapakuwa na vita mpaka mwaka wa thelathini na tano wa kutawala kwake Asa.
sw.B: Hapakuwa na vita mpaka mwaka wa thelathini na tano wa utawala wa Asa.
sw.R: Hapakuwa na vita tena mpaka mwaka wa thelathini na tano tangu Asa alipoanza kutawala.

vi.L: Không có chiến tranh cho đến năm thứ ba mươi lăm triều A-sa.
vi.B: Không có chiến tranh cho đến năm thứ ba mươi lăm triều đại A-sa.
vi.R: Không còn chiến tranh nữa cho đến năm thứ ba mươi lăm A-sa làm vua.

ko.L: 그리고 아사의 통치 제35년까지 전쟁이 없었다.
ko.B: 아사가 다스린 지 35년째 되는 해까지 전쟁이 없었다.
ko.R: 아사가 왕이 된 지 35년째 되는 해까지 다시는 전쟁이 없었다.

pt.L: E não houve guerra até o trigésimo quinto ano do reinado de Asa.
pt.B: Não houve guerra até o trigésimo quinto ano do reinado de Asa.
pt.R: Não houve mais guerra até o trigésimo quinto ano em que Asa era rei.

decisions.choice: the thirty-fifth year: a date hard to fit with Kings
alternatives: counted from the division of the kingdom
a copying error for an earlier year
decisions.reason: According to 1 Kings 15:33 Baasha became king of Israel in Asa's third year and reigned twenty-four years, and 1 Kings 16:8 has his son Elah succeed him in Asa's twenty-sixth year. Yet 16:1 here dates Baasha's attack in Asa's thirty-sixth year, and 1 Kings 15:16 speaks of war between Asa and Baasha all their days. The number may count from the division of the kingdom, so that "the reign of Asa" means the kingdom of Judah he ruled, which would put the war about Asa's fifteenth or sixteenth year; or a number may have been miscopied (for example from fifteen or twenty-five); or Chronicles may be using its own reckoning. The record keeps the text as written.

decisions.choice: no war: the rest Yahweh gave
decisions.reason: The years of peace are the rest of verse 15, given because Judah sought Yahweh. Chapter 16 tells how Asa later relied on Aram instead of on Yahweh, and war returned (16:9).

decisions.choice: no more war
decisions.reason: Readable adds "more", since Judah had just fought Zerah (14:8-14) and the verse speaks of the years after that war.
